d: RLDatix (RLD) is on a mission to help raise the standard of care…everywhere. Trusted by over 10,000 healthcare organizations around the world, our solutions help improve health and care. Our applications ensure that patients receive the best and safest care while supporting the providers who deliver it.
Joining TeamRLD means being part of a global effort of over 2,000 team members in making a difference in healthcare…every day.

We're searching for a Riyadh-based Marketing Specialist to join our Marketing team, so that we can deliver integrated regional marketing programmes that strengthen brand visibility, engage target audiences, generate qualified demand, and support business growth across MEA. The role combines field marketing, events, campaigns, content, digital channels, marketing technology, and performance measurement, converting regional priorities into consistent, measurable marketing outcomes.
r: Analyse campaign, event, and webinar performance and maintain accurate data in dashboards and CRM systems in order to produce actionable reports that demonstrate marketing contribution to regional business growth.
Translate regional business priorities and audience needs into practical marketing plans, campaign briefs, and activity calendars in order to drive consistent, locally relevant execution.
Partner with Sales, business leaders, central marketing teams, and external partners in order to coordinate events, exhibitions, webinars, and seminars and align lead qualification and follow-up.
Plan and execute integrated demand-generation and brand-building campaigns across events, email, digital, social media, partner, and public relations channels in order to engage priority audiences.
Develop and localise audience-focused content and apply agreed attribution methods in order to refine messaging, assess pipeline contribution, and recommend improvements to channel mix and targeting.
What Kind of Things We're Most Interested in You Having

Two to four years of experience delivering integrated B2B marketing programmes in regional or multi-market environments, including events, exhibitions, webinars, seminars, and digital campaigns, with demonstrated success generating qualified leads and contributing to pipeline.
Hands-on experience with marketing automation, CRM, webinar, event-management, digital, social media, and reporting platforms.
Strong capability in marketing planning, audience segmentation, content development, brand governance, agency and vendor coordination, budget management, data analysis, and performance reporting.
Effective project management, cross-functional communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and turn insights into practical improvements.
Native Arabic speaker with professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken, and a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
Sincere interest in making a positive change in healthcare, with experience in healthcare technology, enterprise software, or another regulated B2B industry an advantage.
By enabling flexibility in how we work and prioritizing employee wellness, we empower our team to do and be their best. Our benefits package is designed to support your health, wellbeing, and future.
RLDatix is an equal opportunity employer, and our employment decisions are made in accordance with applicable law and without unlawful discrimination.

As part of RLDatix's commitment to the inclusion of all qualified individuals, we ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation in the job application and interview process. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in either step, please don't hesitate to send a note to accessibility@rldatix.com.

d: Own the paid media engine for a $1Billion+ brand. Decide what to launch and where the budget goes.
Total Annual Package: Up to USD $240,000 + comprehensive benefits (Base salary + monthly performance bonus of up to 20% of base)

Growth path from here is fluid: all paid channels, including the ones you select, moving toward scope at the intersection of capital allocation, creative strategy, and P&L ownership. What takes 4-5 years elsewhere happens in 1-2 here.
We've been AI-first since December 2023: Every proposal that reaches the CEO ships with an LLM validation link. Your first spend case gets stress-tested by an advanced model to eliminate blind spots.

Puffy, a market-leading, nine-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1 billion in sales, is hiring a Senior Director of Performance Marketing to own a multi-million-dollar monthly paid media engine across Google and Meta with full authority over systems, measurement, creative testing, capital allocation, and team, reporting directly to the CEO.

This role exists to convert a multi-million-dollar paid budget into maximum contribution margin, building the decision systems, measurement infrastructure, and team that let the revenue engine run and scale without day-to-day executive involvement.
q: 7+ years in performance marketing with sustained ownership of $1M+/month on both Google and Meta (concurrently or across roles). "Ownership" means authority over strategy, structure, and budget, not just execution.
Google depth at PMax-era: campaign structure, feed management, brand/non-brand economics.
High-AOV considered-purchase experience ($1,000+ order values): sparse-conversion, long-decision-cycle categories.
Personally built, not inherited, bid, budget, and pause decision systems at scale. You'll be asked to present a playbook you authored.
Statistical decision literacy: volume gating, false-kill vs. wasted-spend trade-offs, threshold derivation, incrementality test design.
Creative testing systems at scale in a post-ATT environment: concept-vs-variation discipline, creative analytics.
Team leadership including senior direct reports. Experience building or restructuring a performance marketing function.
Structured approach to new channel evaluation: selection frameworks, pilot design, budget allocation, and kill criteria.
Scripting against Meta/Google APIs; Google Ads Scripts.
Experience with emerging paid channels (e.g., TikTok, Connected TV, affiliate/partnerships, etc.).
D2C e-commerce background in home goods, furniture, or comparable high-AOV verticals.
We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size.
Be the Owner: We don't hire employees; we welcome owners. You're accountable for results, not activity.
Execute with Urgency: We thrive in high-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively.
Demand Excellence: We solve the hard problems that others can't, pushing the boundaries of our craft.
Be AI-First: Daily multi-turn AI conversations challenge your assumptions.
Go All-In: When the mission demands it, we rally as one team to cross the finish line.
r: Primary: Decide what to launch and where the budget goes: A multi-million-dollar monthly budget runs across Google and Meta, and every standard campaign type is already live and optimized: brand and non-brand search, PMax, Meta prospecting and retargeting, Shopping and feed. Growth now has to come from what isn't running: new campaign structures, new creative, a different mix of spend.

Secondary: Build the system that runs the scaling decisions: Design and document the rules that govern spend, when to pause, when to increase budget, when to pull back, and the measurement each decision depends on. The system should run the scaling without day-to-day executive oversight.
This is not a role where you manage dashboards and present decks.

The scope is scarce : very few Senior Directors of Performance Marketing get simultaneous authority over multi-million-dollar monthly budgets on both major platforms, full ownership of measurement and creative systems, org design power, and a direct line to the CEO with no layers in between.

Your first 12 months: build pause/hold/scale logic, budget guardrails, and escalation protocols from scratch. Deploy incrementality testing and reconcile platform attribution against backend reality. Architect the creative engine as a system: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, and whitelisting. Design capital allocation on marginal return rather than platform-reported averages. Design promo architecture across the retail calendar: pulse strategy, financing offers, funnel alignment. Identify, evaluate, and pilot paid channels beyond Google and Meta. Structure the performance marketing function itself. Shape the future of performance marketing at Puffy, where paid media is the primary growth lever.
What Is In It For You
This isn't just another performance marketing role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.
Own the Paid Engine End to End, With No Layers Above You
You set the strategy, build the systems, and own the outcomes.

You allocate multi-million-dollar monthly budgets across Google and Meta on marginal return rather than platform-reported averages, design the pause/hold/scale logic and budget guardrails that govern all paid spend, and serve as the single source of truth on paid media performance. Creative runs as a system you architect: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, whitelisting.

You hold profitability to a contribution-margin standard after returns and financing costs, not ROAS in isolation. You lead, assess, and structure the performance marketing function with org design authority and CEO sign-off, reporting directly to the CEO.
Join a High-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:
🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1 Billion USD in Sales
💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Your vision is the company's vision.
Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high-velocity execution that drives a global brand

Work from anywhere in the world with meaningful time zone overlap. Structure your environment around your best thinking, whether that's a home office, a co-working space, (OR) our Dubai headquarters (with full relocation, visa support, and 0% income tax if you choose). Your output is your credential, not your location.
Become the Operator Other Brands Try to Hire

In most companies, performance marketing leaders inherit a system somebody else built and spend the next three years defending its numbers in meetings. Here you build it. When the CEO decides how much capital goes into growth next quarter, your model is the input to that decision, not a report on it afterwards. You'll leave with a paid media system you designed end to end, and the proof that it held contribution margin at scale, which is the part almost nobody in this function can actually show. Puffy has been AI-First since December 2023, so you'll build it with an AI-native toolbox behind you rather than an agency deck in front of you.
x: 💰 Compensation: Total Annual Package: Up to USD $240,000 + comprehensive benefits (Base salary + monthly performance bonus of up to 20% of base)
🏥 Health & Protection: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance (based on country of hire)
🌴 Time Off: Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) + Public holidays
AI-First organization with access to AI-native tool stack
Remote First: Work from the comfort of your home office
International team collaboration across 16+ nationalities. Your assumptions get challenged daily.
Eligibility for selection to the Leaders Club, an elite recognition program featuring premium wellness memberships, exclusive networking with senior leadership, and annual leadership retreats
Eligibility for nomination as 'We Are' Champion of the Month, monthly recognition with gift vouchers and company-wide celebration for exceptional contributions

We are looking for a Senior Legal Operations Executive to make our legal team run smoothly — contracts, vendor spend, billing, and the systems behind them. You'll look for better ways of doing things and work with colleagues across Legal, Finance, Procurement and engineering to make it happen. The role reports to the Head of Legal Operations.
q: 5+ years in legal operations or a related role (e.g. legal finance, contract management, in-house legal support).
Experience designing processes that handle high volumes of payment requests and documentation accurately.
Confident working with large datasets and spreadsheets.
Fluency in English is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders. Additional languages would be an advantage.
Comfortable making decisions and escalating only what needs escalating.
Experience administering or implementing a matter management, contract management or e-billing platform.
Scripting skills, or experience working with engineers on automation (e.g. Python, APIs, low-code tools).
Experience in a regulated industry, ideally fintech or crypto.
Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy
Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team)
Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

r: Contracts . Own the contract execution and filing process end to end, so that contracts are issued, recorded and easy to retrieve for the legal team and stakeholders across the business.
Budget and billing . Oversee payment requests and invoice review, work with Finance to resolve billing issues, and support budget tracking and forecasting.
Vendors . Manage vendor onboarding, renewals and rate-card administration, and enforce our External Legal Counsel Guidelines with law firms.

Systems . Manage the relationship with our matter management and e-signature platform vendors, and oversee integrations and configurations, such as approval workflows. Help colleagues get more out of the tools.
Process improvement and automation . Identify manual processes, design more efficient ways of working, and drive automation through to delivery.
Documentation . Keep process documentation up to date.
